description: ADMIN: Creates a new menu item on a restaurant. Only restaurant_id and name are required - set price_cents before the item can be meaningfully ordered. New items start active and available; use update_menu_item to change them later. Requires pac_cordinator or lunch_cordinator role. WRITE operation - confirm with the user. Get restaurant_id from list_school_restaurants.

cost_cents.description: Kitchen cost in cents (internal margin tracking)

name.description: Item display name shown to parents

name: create_menu_item

isActive.description: Whether the item is on the restaurant menu

title: Create Menu Item (Admin)
